items.claim: CEO says China revenue came in better than the earlier prudent 'flat' guide, growing this year instead.
items.quote: China is growing this year, which is good.
items.speaker: Anirudh Devgan (CEO)

items.claim: CEO gives China's current share of total revenue and notes it is down from a few years ago.
items.quote: China will be in 11%, 12% of revenue
items.speaker: Anirudh Devgan (CEO)

items.claim: CEO states last year's revenue growth rate while discussing the growth+margin 'rule of X' framework.
items.quote: our revenue growth last year is 14%.
items.speaker: Anirudh Devgan (CEO)

items.claim: CEO states this year's operating margin figure.
items.quote: our operating margin. This year is about 44.5%
items.speaker: Anirudh Devgan (CEO)

items.claim: CEO defines 'real margin' as operating margin minus stock-based compensation.
items.quote: real margin is, of course, operating margin minus SBC.
items.speaker: Anirudh Devgan (CEO)

items.claim: CEO states incremental margin on the organic business.
items.quote: incremental margin on our organic business is close to 60%.
items.speaker: Anirudh Devgan (CEO)

items.claim: CEO restates the company's long-standing incremental margin goal.
items.quote: our goal, of course, is a 50% plus incremental margin
items.speaker: Anirudh Devgan (CEO)

items.claim: CEO says buybacks funded by cash flow exceed the SBC percentage, aimed at avoiding dilution.
items.quote: So if we do like 8%, 9% SBC, we buy back more than that.
items.speaker: Anirudh Devgan (CEO)

items.claim: CEO states the primary strategic rationale for the Hexagon acquisition.
items.quote: the reason for Hexagon was, is primarily for physical AI.
items.speaker: Anirudh Devgan (CEO)

items.claim: CEO describes the acquired Hexagon simulation asset as the market leader in multibody dynamics simulation.
items.quote: the best multibody dynamic simulator, #1 in the market.
items.speaker: Anirudh Devgan (CEO)

items.claim: CEO says Cadence now has all five key advanced-node IP categories (UCIe, HBM, DDR, PCIe, SerDes).
items.quote: we have all the 5 key IPs at the most advanced nodes.
items.speaker: Anirudh Devgan (CEO)

items.claim: Analyst references a recent stumble by a rival IP vendor as context for the question on Cadence's IP positioning.
items.quote: misstep perhaps with a rival recently in this space
items.speaker: Unknown Analyst

items.claim: CEO characterizes the NVIDIA business relationship as expanding.
items.quote: our business with NVIDIA is growing.
items.speaker: Anirudh Devgan (CEO)

items.claim: Analyst asks about a reported nonexclusive collaboration deal between NVIDIA and Synopsys.
items.quote: a nonexclusive deal done or collaboration with Synopsys
items.speaker: Unknown Analyst

items.claim: CEO acknowledges Cadence was subject to a China-related export ban lasting six weeks during the year.
items.quote: we were banned for 6 weeks and all that.
items.speaker: Anirudh Devgan (CEO)

items.claim: CEO notes a quarter-to-quarter revenue timing shift tied to the China situation.
items.quote: some revenue moved from Q2 to Q3.
items.speaker: Anirudh Devgan (CEO)

items.claim: CEO gives the current split of customers between system companies and semiconductor companies.
items.quote: about 45% of our customers are now system companies
items.speaker: Anirudh Devgan (CEO)

items.claim: CEO states the concentration of revenue among a small set of large customers.
items.quote: 70% of revenue is coming from about 60 companies
items.speaker: Anirudh Devgan (CEO)

items.claim: CEO commits to a systems business run-rate target, conditioned on M&A closing.
items.quote: we will cross like $1 billion run rate in systems
items.speaker: Anirudh Devgan (CEO)

items.claim: CEO commits that no future M&A will be allowed to undermine the company's margin-expansion financial model.
items.quote: we'll not do any M&A that destroy this fundamental financial
items.speaker: Anirudh Devgan (CEO)

items.claim: Analyst raises margin pressure from the shift to annual subscriptions in the SD&A (systems) business as a topic needing explanation.
items.quote: a little bit of margin pressure as you transition to annual
items.speaker: Unknown Analyst

qa_flags.question: And should we focus on that nonexclusivity in that deal when thinking about yourselves?
qa_flags.response_pattern: Management answered at length about the NVIDIA partnership's growth and gave a brief, sentence-cut-off mention of ongoing Intel discussions, but never addressed the specific question about the Synopsys deal's nonexclusivity.

qa_flags.question: What sort of margin pressure should we expect?
qa_flags.response_pattern: Management gave a qualitative, non-quantified answer ('there might be some 1-year impact... not going to be that significant given our scale') rather than a specific margin-pressure figure.
